notes.title: Custom Language Files and Backup Saves
notes.content:
The latest update (v.2.1.1) for Shisensho Solitaire enables users to create a custom language file. I'm hoping that over time, players will voluntarily translate the game into their native languages, and share them with me so I can make them official. Credit will be given, of course!

Guide: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2310550097]How to Make a Custom Language File[/url]

Also, the game now automatically creates a local backup save file every time you play (up to 20). While I've not had any reports of players losing their progress, it's always a good idea to keep backups. For an explanation of how saving, backups and Steam Cloud work in Shisensho Solitaire, see this guide:

Guide: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2310522298]How to Restore Progress from Backup[/url]

Finally, if you missed the forum post, the previous update (v.2.1.0) added a way to cycle through all the moves available on the board when using the Hint button. Prior to that update only one move was highlighted. In addition, I added a music track selector to the in-game Settings menu (cog icon) so you can switch between songs while playing.

Thanks for playing!
Nick

notes.title: Bonus Campaign - 91 New Levels
notes.content:
Hi everyone, this update adds a 91-level Bonus Campaign that brings the total number of puzzles to 182. 

To unlock the bonus levels, complete the main campaign and an arrow will appear by the Campaign Map. This arrow will open the Bonus Campaign. The new campaign is much like the first - it starts with small, easy boards and gets progressively more difficult. You can enable Hint, Undo, Shuffle and Spotlight from the Bonus Campaign Map's "Options" button.

Also, in the Audio Menu, you can now change the volume of each individual sound effect.

If you find any bugs, please let me know in the Steam forums or via Twitter, and I'll race to fix them ASAP.

Thanks for reading! I hope you enjoy the update. :)

~ Nick
@JapanGamer29

notes.title: Major Update - Shisensho Solitaire 2.0
notes.content:
Hi everyone, for the last few months I've been busy working on a major overhaul of Shisensho. Here's what's new:

* Playable tutorial
* 91-level campaign mode (with Casual option)
* 14 new achievements (44 total)
* 10 awards (for veteran players)
* 5 new tile sets (8 total)
* 2 new Mini Game board sizes (6x4, 8x5)
* 14 all-new backgrounds
* 2 new leaderboards: Total Wins and Tiles Cleared
* Mid-game saving
* Joker tiles (don't need matching)
* Best 100 times saved per board (up from 10) 
* View ALL Steam Leaderboard entries (up from 10)
* Improved Shuffle (tiles move, not just their faces)
* Improved Undo (works through Shuffle and mid-game save)
* All-new menus
* Basic camera zoom (use mouse wheel)
* Replay board option when out of moves or time
* Mouse pointer size option 
* This is a free update :)

[b]About upgrading:[/b]

Upgrading is automatic and your progress from Shisensho 1 will be continued. However, your in-game settings (background color, screen resolution, audio settings, etc.) are not carried over to version 2. Sorry about that. Please explore the new Options menu.

[b]Downgrading back to version 1.3:[/b]

The files with your old settings and progress are not changed so you can revert to version 1.3 at any time by right clicking Shisensho Solitaire in your Steam library -> Properties -> Betas -> shisensho_v1.3 (Legacy version).

[b]About Steam Cloud:[/b]

Shisensho saves your game progress to Steam Cloud. However, settings and any mid-game saves are only saved locally.

[b]Bug reporting:[/b]

If you find any bugs, please let me know in the Steam forums or via Twitter, and I'll race to fix them ASAP.

Thanks for reading! I hope you enjoy the update. :)

~ Nick
@JapanGamer29

notes.title: Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
Shisensho now has a demo which I've made in the hope that more people will try this classic game.

[b]What can you do in the demo?[/b]

In the demo, you can play Regular, Casual, Time Attack and Mini game modes [u]without any limitations[/u] of any kind. You can even see how many times you've won in each mode. 

[b]How is the Full game different?[/b]

The full game has a "[b]Player Stats[/b]" page which shows all your wins in one place, how many games you've lost, your fastest times, and your progress through the game's 30 [b]achievements[/b]. You can also see the "[b]Leaderboards[/b]" page which ranks your top-ten times for each board size, and view both global and friends' leaderboards. Compete with other people for the most wins and fastest times. Finally, the full game includes [b]Steam Cloud[/b] saving for your progress.

[b]Upgrading from the demo[/b]

If you enjoy the demo and would like to buy the full game - thank you! Please note that the demo and full game will be completely separate on your computer. No progress or settings are carried over.

As always, thank you for your support, and I'm happy to answer any questions you may have.

~ Nick.

notes.title: "Lose X games" Patch 1.2.5
notes.content:
Hi everyone, just a small announcement:

I wanted to make the "Lose X games" achievements easier to get. So now, in addition to getting "No more moves", you can also lose by running out of time in a Mini Game, or quitting any active game when paused.

Oh, as a BONUS! I've included a new, alternative set of Mahjong tiles.

Here's a comparison between the current set, and the new set:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35889657/7a63107044a60b12bb255b5b9a630cc5e41eeb23.png[/img]

 Find them in OPTIONS - > TILE STYLE -> Mahjong 2.

One last thing for the Time Attack challengers; the previous patch, 1.2.4, added a shortcut for quickly restarting a game. Just press SHIFT + R.  

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Shisensho Solitaire v.1.2 Update
notes.content:
Welcome one and all to the latest version of Shisensho Solitaire! 

Version 1.2 introduces two new board sizes to fit between "Mini" and the current "Large" size. The new boards, "Small" and "Medium", both have corresponding Time Attack leaderboards and personal top 10 rankings.

You can change the board size in a Regular, Casual or Time Attack game before you click your first tile. There's a new icon in the toolbar, or just press "B". There's also a setting in Options if you prefer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35889657/a6bea4a86972667ca551eb505311b6e0a80fd1a2.png[/img]

By the way, pro tip, you can also change the background color on the fly. Simply press "G". :)

For the achievement hunters among you, there haven't been any changes. BUT! With smaller board sizes, you should find it [i]much[/i] faster to earn those achievements for 50 and 100 wins and losses. Can you get 100%? Sure you can! 

Another addition is "30 seconds" (!!) for the Mini Game timer. That may sound crazy, but a good challenge for our hardcore players. For an easier experience, there are already options for up to 90 seconds or simply disabling the timer. See Options -> Advanced Settings -> Mini Game Timer.

Speaking of easier experiences, version 1.1 added a way to switch directly from a frustrating Regular or Time Attack game to a Casual mode game. This is especially helpful if you're stuck looking for a pair of matching tiles and feel like giving up. Now, you can switch to Casual mode and use the Hint and Shuffle options to continue the game. Here's how:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35889657/079d6c24ad10c89f2f439cbf3e65fafbc436621b.png[/img]

Of course, this means that the Time Attack stopwatch will disappear and the win will count as a Casual one, but it's better than quitting out of frustration, right?

Here's the full changelog for v1.2.0:

- New board sizes: Small (12x6) and Medium (14x7) - 2,000+ solvable puzzles.
- New icon for changing board sizes at start of each game.
- New menu option for changing board size
- New leaderboards for Small and Medium Time Attack results.
- New personal top 10 rankings for Small and Medium boards.
- New hotkeys: "B" for Board Size, and "G" for Background color.
- New: Jump from the Leaderboards screen straight into a Time Attack game.
- Time Attack achievement descriptions updated to say "Large board".
- Improved big menu tiles for the "Colors" tile-style.
- Music now fades out on game exit.
- New 30 second option for the hardcore Mini Game players :)

As always, you can see all the patch notes in the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/1161360/discussions/"]discussion forum[/url].

If you're enjoying Shisensho Solitaire, please consider leaving a review. The store page should be [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1161360/Shisensho_Solitaire/]here[/url]. Thank you!

notes.title: Shisensho Solitaire v.1.1 Update
notes.content:
Version 1.1 of Shisensho Solitaire is a big Color and Audio update!

First of all, we now have all seven songs from Keevin's album, "LoFi from the East Side album". If you like what you hear, you can support Keevin on [url=https://open.spotify.com/artist/69SXHig6qVBYusDYQdGYTI]Spotify[/url] and [url=https://soundcloud.com/user-169430853]Soundcloud[/url].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35889657/74f532de30ab6ed9d238b33b5bbee0de35748a03.jpg[/img]

Other big changes are:

* A choice of background colors. Choose from Red, Blue, Black and Green.
* Full Audio Settings. Separate volume options for Master, Music and Sound FX.
* Change the Mini Game time limit: 45, 60 (default), 75 or 90 seconds.

Other changes include:

* New Advanced Settings for toggling image smoothing, tooltips and mouse pointers.
* Briefly see the song title in the corner when a new track starts playing. You can skip a track at any time by toggling the music off and on with the "M" key.
* When exiting the game from the main menu, you'll be prompted to confirm.

And various bug fixes, including a couple of big ones nobody noticed. ;)

See the patch notes in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1161360/discussions/]Discussion forum[/url] for full details about this and all the previous updates you may have missed - there have been quite a few!

notes.title: Shisensho Solitaire is Now Available!
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience. I'm happy to announce the launch of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1161360/Shisensho_Solitaire/]Shisensho Solitaire[/url].

When you first start the game, I recommend going into the Options menu and playing with the settings there. Then check out the "How to Play" screen - the rules aren't quite the same as Mahjong Solitaire! Then maybe try a Casual Game, which gives you Undo, Hint, and Shuffle features. 

Do check out the "Player Stats" screen to see the Achievements, and from there you can access the Leaderboards. Already, the fastest Time Attack score is a lightning quick 4 minutes!

You can ask me any questions in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1161360/discussions/]Discussion forum[/url]. 

I hope you enjoy the game!

Best regards,
Nick Ramsay, aka JapanGamer29
